results.objective: Add the Cotton Tee to the cart. On the cart page, untick any optional add-on so only the Cotton Tee remains, then read and remember the cart Total. Click Checkout. If there is a guest option use it; otherwise create an account with email demo-shopper@example.com and password demo-pass-1234 (this is a demo store). On the payment page, read the Total to pay and assert it equals the cart Total you remembered.
results.fix: Show every mandatory fee in the price from the first moment (product page and cart), never only on the final payment step.
